metadata.note: Previous control points were retired because Explorer coordinates were formula-derived from source image coordinates. V2 registration must use independent sourceVisual and explorerVisual top-left image coordinates selected manually.
metadata.yAxis: Explorer map Y is Leaflet/app Y; convert visual image Y with explorerY = 7168 - visualImageY.

coordinateConventions.sourceVisual: Top-left visual image coordinates from the RDO reference image; Y increases downward.
coordinateConventions.explorerVisual: Top-left visual image coordinates from images/rdr2-map.jpg; Y increases downward.
coordinateConventions.leafletConversion: Convert transformed Explorer visual coordinates with explorerVisualToLeafletCoordinates(x, visualY).
